name: io.github.AdversTM/sftp-mcp
title: SFTP
description: SFTP-only file access for AI: browse, edit, transfer and sync files, no shell access needed.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Path to a private key file.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_SERVERS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSON map of server id to connection, for multiple servers. Replaces the single-server variables.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to deny delete, rmdir, rename and non-dry-run sync.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_ALLOWED_WRITE_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Absolute remote path prefix that mutations are limited to.

environmentVariables.name: SFTP_ALLOWED_READ_PREFIX
environmentVariables.description: Absolute remote path prefix that reads are limited to.
